title: Lifestyle habits to boost your hormonal profile
summary: NH argues most poor hormonal profiles are self-inflicted and fixed over years by removing toxic habits rather than buying supplements or TRT. His prescriptions are training, sunlight, daily walking, filtered water, home-cooked whole and organic foods, avoiding microwaves and junk, and plenty of sleep without an alarm, introduced step by step.
claims: TRT is the easy way out; you should make your body more anabolic instead of injecting hormones
For most people, low testosterone and poor recovery are self-inflicted by lifestyle, not fate
Fixing a damaged hormonal profile takes as long as the damage took, or longer; there is no two-week hack
He looked like he had a poor hormonal profile but simply did things that made his body feel better and they compounded
Training is the backbone: damaging the body triggers hormonal supercompensation that gradually raises testosterone
Men who stay active into their 60s and 70s are those who were always active
Get 20-30 minutes of sun on your skin daily; screens are not sunlight
Lifting alone isn't enough activity; walk 40-50 minutes a day and choose to carry groceries rather than drive
Being stationary encourages muscle and tendon pain and a degenerative lifestyle
Tap water carries hormones and toxins that filtration doesn't remove; filter it or use reverse osmosis
Filtered water lacks minerals, so get minerals from a good diet or mineral supplements
Your body may be too busy fighting toxins to prioritise muscle building
Processed food is anything prepared for you; the more steps in making it, the more additives and the worse it is
Eat whole foods you cook from scratch, controlling the cooking, salt and condiments yourself
He uses the oven and pans instead of the microwave; his body composition and hormones improved after switching
Buy organic, pesticide-free food; work overtime if needed to afford it, and buy from local farms in the countryside
Food manufacturers optimise taste and addiction within the law, not your health
Even with perfect macros, poor food quality will damage your hormonal profile
A poor hormonal profile also affects mental health: depression, anxiety and aggression
Sleep eight hours if you need eight; skipping sleep is like quitting the workout halfway
Wake without an alarm when you can so your body recovers fully
Recovery is what lets you increase frequency and muscle damage and grow over time
Introduce these changes step by step; removing junk at once can make the body fight back with acne or feeling bad
He used to eat fast food every Friday and boxed pasta at 15 and now eats only whole foods for life
Video games are escapism that make you okay with virtual achievements; don't spend five hours on them
Applied from today, these habits show results in 5-10 years
